doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line. Hero pairing: Any. Doctrine 'Don't put' is a literal X placeholder in the OP -- not fabricated here. No 'Tips & Tricks' section present in this thread (structural absence, not a capture gap); thread goes directly from Doctrines/Example Build to the SOS freshness note. Playstyle kit: press 1 for RTS view control mode (damage + charge stance), press 2 for a Khevtuul/Kriegsbruders-style sweep around the unit, press 3 to heal. Example build per OP: Unit Damage Doctrine V, Epic Combat Doctrine (3/6/9), Order of the Dragon Unique Doctrine (Emperor's Expedition +15% move speed), +15% Pen Doctrine (above 40% HP), Flatland Doctrine V or Epic Leadership Doctrine or -5% DMG Taken. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset -- Order of the Dragon is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
